resources.string: Auto-solver used — this game won’t be scored.

At Insane level, the board edges wrap around; cells on the right edge connect to those on the left edge, and vice versa. Similarly for the top and bottom edges. But in addition, in cells with 3 or 4 connections, the wiring is invisible. Good luck!

At Abyss level, the board is endless: it covers 40 by 40 cells and its edges wrap around, so panning never reveals any end of the board. In addition, in cells with 3 or 4 connections, the wiring is invisible. Good luck!

At Void level, the board is endless: it covers 40 by 40 cells and its edges wrap around. In cells with 3 or 4 connections, the wiring is invisible. And in addition, a fog hides the cells away from the network connected to the server: only the surroundings of the connected cells stay visible. Good luck!
